findings.claim: The repository cargo-deny advisory policy does not ignore the new `RUSTSEC-2026-0235` advisory that the CI audit job explicitly has to suppress, so the dependency-policy advisory gate can still fail.
findings.evidence: The workflow adds `ignore: RUSTSEC-2026-0235,RUSTSEC-2023-0071` with a comment explaining the rkyv advisory is reachable through the SurrealDB graph, but the `deny.toml` advisory ignore additions include only `RUSTSEC-2025-0141` and `RUSTSEC-2023-0071`; the acceptance context states cargo-deny owns repository license/source/advisory policy in `deny.toml`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a scoped `RUSTSEC-2026-0235` advisory ignore with the same SurrealDB/rkyv justification to `deny.toml`, or remove the workflow ignore if the advisory is not actually present.
